text: Apple's published codec, size and length limits (H.264 High Profile Level 4.0 at 10-12 Mbps or ProRes 422 HQ; .mov/.m4v/.mp4; 500 MB; 15-30 s; Mac previews 1920x1080 landscape) are for App Store app previews. text: App Review's own forum tips say to put hardware-related demonstrations in the Notes field of the version's App Review Information. For hardware integration it asks for a video of the real hardware plus the app on a physical device, not only a screen recording. A network monitor needs no accessory, so a screen recording suffices. text: Attach the recording to App Review Information or the reply as the default, so the reviewer needs no external access and the evidence stays with the submission. Use a link only if the upload fails or the file is too large, and then prefer a long-lived unlisted URL over an expiring share link, with the access note in Notes. This is inference from the documented 4000-byte Notes and attach-file support, not an Apple rule. (low confidence)
